horoscopes.horoscope: Carry the peace sign if you have to, because today, people will literally pull you into arguments. You could even be facing some kind of litigation or trouble with peace-keeping forces, warns Ganesha. Meditate, walk, or simply seek the company of friends and loved ones. Your relationship might ask for adjustments. A forgiving attitude will be helpful in maintaining harmony. You may not be in a mood to make the relationship complicated. You will have to keep patience and help your sweetheart think openly and in a flexible manner, suggests Ganesha. Feeling low since morning, you may avoid going to the office and just lie down in bed. However, Ganesha advises you to finish urgent work on hand, and thereafter spend rest of the day in the company of friends or family. With pending dues worrying you, Ganesha advises you to start hunting for a better-paying job so that you can clear off all your debts as soon as possible. Also, look out for other money-making channels. Small issues may drive you crazy in the workplace. More or less, you will be in a mood to sacrifice for others. You want a memorable start today. Your mind will be at its creative best and will force you to focus on innovative ideas.

Today is a day of closure. You may find yourself on the winning side of things, says Ganesha. Pending projects will reach completion and you will achieve satisfaction and success in education. With a little extra effort, you can build a castle from stone. Ganesha wishes you a cheerful and colourful day. You will be in a commanding position in love life. However, you don’t seem to be taking advantage of it. What matters to you today is ’emotions’. You will think a lot to express your sweetheart but fortunately, you will receive a green signal from your beloved. Ganesha says, that you’ll be diverted from your focus at work today. Try to focus, as unfinished task needs to meet the deadlines. Health front looks great. It’s a favorable day to enroll in some physical exercises. You’ll be full of positive energy now. Ganesha advises you to spend money on friends for the sake of their happiness, as it will also make you happy. Give them a treat, throw a party. Such generosity will bring in big rewards in the future. You may not be yourself today, as you might opt for short-cuts in order to get work done. You seem to be shifting your focus from your prime responsibilities to minor activities. You may feel confident to finish the pending work in time. You will leave your progress in the hands of God.

Today, you are likely to remain transparent in all your dealings, forecasts Ganesha. You can be optimistic about your chances of success if you choose to propose to that special someone. The day will bring more pleasure than pain. You want to bring the joy on the face of your partner. Happiness is the first priority in the relationship. You may share some secret things that may sound interesting to your partner. You may be on cloud nine as your romantic life seems to blossom in the evening. Ganesha feels, that you are likely to finish your task with great perfection today. As a result, you’ll be in a positive mood throughout. You may face some confusion in taking the decision now. Health looks good. Try to spend some good time with family. Ganesha feels that you shall be busy with work. You will also be confused about your career path and progress. You will not be in a mood to step out of the comfort zone to increase your earnings. You may want to be perfect in your work but confusions may crop up in various matters. Though attaining perfection is difficult, it isn’t impossible. As hours pass by, you will regain the ability to take the correct decisions. You may want to use different strategies to achieve the results.

There is something different about today. It is unlike any other day. Just when you will start believing that there is nothing great about the day, it will spring a surprise. There have been days where life has thrown carrots at you; then there have been days when it has hurled brickbats. Today, you will be on the receiving end of countless kisses. Ganesha feels you will maintain a good relationship with your loved one. Slowly but steadily you tend to develop your romance. Emotionally, you will get closer to each other. Your sympathetic nature will attract the person of the opposite sex. It’s a lovely time to propose if you are in love. Ganesha says, that you are likely to be in a mood to do something new today. Health looks fine, so you’ll be able to initiate new things. Decisions taking may get difficult. You may enjoy some creative work, as it will improve your sense of satisfaction. Ganesha feels that regarding money matters, today is going to be a lucky day for you. Try to settle abroad for work. The time is favourable to get a visa or work permit. Overall, a favourable day is on the cards. Creative work will excite you today and ideas will come naturally. However, at the same time going for the best alternative will be difficult. You will have the potential today to tap big opportunities to deal with the big clients. In fact, you seem to develop friendly relations with everyone you come across.

Honesty and sincerity are your hallmarks. Being a Leo, it is no surprise that you value these two attributes above all else, says Ganesha. But it also means that you should not be surprised to find yourself today in a situation that somehow feels like a landmark moment in your life. Whether it is a personal matter or something related to work, that you must wait to find out. But the one thing assured is that your social reputation shall receive a tremendous boost today. Thankfully, the day ends on a positive note as you enjoy a gala time with your lover. You may spend the quality time with your partner at a restaurant or garden discussing your core strength and future. You tend to pour all your emotions on your beloved. It is likely that your health may not remain good today, says Ganesha. You may get tired easily. As there are chances of ill health today, you should not do such tasks which involve more physical hard work and exertion. If you don’t know what to do, speak with someone who is financially successful. They say that one has to take risks to progress in life but the risk has to be a calculated risk. You may feel disheartened today because you may not be able to complete a specific task before the deadline. You will get more tensed when superiors will start persuading you. You should not feel depressed. Instead, concentrate on work and try to achieve targets, suggests Ganesha.

The artist, the comedian and the showman in you are all set to take the floor today. Entertain people and set the evening ablaze with your arsenal of jokes and gags, says Ganesha. But save valuable time and energy for other pressing matters and responsibilities too. Domestic responsibilities will worry you tonight. Nevertheless, planning a small outing with your family and beloved, you will have a gala time in the evening. You may catch everybody’s attention in the family and show your pride for your life partner. Health wise, this is not a bad day. You will be dealing with lot many people today. You will get to learn something new. As you believe in living life in a more organized way, you will not face any major issue. Ganesha feels that today you will be able to make good money through your professional circle. Your partner will also contribute to your financial progress. You need to trust your partner more. The work load in office will keep you engaged throughout the day. However, today you will succeed in keeping professional and personal lives separate and not let the domestic worries hamper your work. You may have to agree with the views of people you meet.

It is more than likely, and possible indeed, that you will surpass your own past performances today. All this is on the cards, despite the fact that your peers at work will try to outwit you. But it is your consummate set of skills that shall help you pre-empt all such attempts, says Ganesha. If it is some peace that you are looking for today, expect to find it in meditation. The only way to ease out your stressed nerves is to be in the company of your sweetheart. Luckily for you, your partner will enjoy pampering you. This is the time to make a long-term commitment. Marriage is on the cards for the singles. It’s going to be an average day for you on health and related matters. Your schedule will be busy and you won’t find time for yourself. You should have proper foods and juices in order to avoid fatigue, says Ganesha. If you don’t need to upgrade your vehicle right now, don’t go for it just because someone else has bought new vehicle. Competition with others will drain you financially. Commitment to work will be noteworthy. You will definitely be praised for your quality projects. The hectic schedule may leave you bored and exhausted. You will like to engage in some leisure activities with your teammates. You should take advantage of learning some important skills, suggests Ganesha.

You will see every colour of the kaleidoscope today — people with different temperaments and different attitudes, many of whom will surprise you with their reactions. You may be shocked at the way your colleagues or close friends react to your strategies or success. Ganesha advises you to handle people with tact and diplomacy rather than being indifferent or arrogant. You are seeking for peaceful moments with your companion, feels Ganesha. Ganesha assures that with the help of your sweetheart it would not be difficult to enjoy a quality time full of pleasure. You will have a blissful night together, says Ganesha. You will be sensitive today but you really should be creative. You will also be able to maintain good health, says Ganesha. As you will be doing something that satisfies you, you will feel a great sense of satisfaction in you. The day is good for investing money behind study of new subjects. If you are a family man with responsibility of kids, investments done for their studies will be worth so you should do that. You may draw inspiration from your seniors and you will be so much absorbed in the work that you may even forget to eat. Your focus and aggression will make you competitive and help achieve the desired results. Your superiors will praise you for achieving the targets or deadlines.

You are on a high today and a feeling of ecstasy surrounds you. You are performance driven and shall give you best in anything you take up. Listen to your inner voice, it will guide you to the correct path. Ganesha showers His benevolent blessings on you. Make the most of this day. Your evening will be spent making your life partner happy. Your creative energy and imagination power will bring your sweetheart closer and help maintain a long-term relationship. You tend to expect more from your partner and by the blessing of the stars, it will be possible. Ganesha feels, that you might feel low due to your exhausting schedule. Try to control your emotions as it may make the relations more strained. You’ll get affected by the the circumstances easily. Try to relax and stay calm for the day. Ganesha predicts that you will feel like buying a new house or a car, and you may go ahead as the planets are favouring you on the financial front. This is a good day for monetary matters. You need your space to achieve the best results. You hate interruption when you are concentrating on work. However, today, in the office, your mind may be occupied by domestic responsibilities you have to fulfill. Just keep your calm and let the day pass.

You have meticulously planned every aspect of your plan and prepared the check list. The only thing left now to do is execution of that plan. Delays and obstacles, however, will block your path and will leave you disheartened. Don’t doubt your abilities though. You have planned properly and have faith as those delays are not permanent, assures Ganesha. You may go for an open discussion with your life partner about expectations and plans for the future. You may start planning for the most amazing lifestyle. You should be prepared to listen to your partner. The joint decision making should be your top priority. Health wise, it’s a good day for you but not a perfect day, says Ganesha. You will also be more logical and calculative today. Emotions won’t be able to overwhelm you. You can also plan short distance trips today to rejuvenate yourself. Don’t be afraid of lending money to your family members, they will return in time. Ganesha feels that the day is good for planning long drive or short distance joy trips with friends or friend-like siblings. You should avoid taking up a new project until you have thoroughly gone through the previous one, says Ganesha. Reviewing the work will definitely help in determining the path ahead. Your suggestions may bring a valuable change in the workplace, foresees Ganesha.

Don’t let your emotions play a spoilsport in the important decisions of your life. The tendency to be sentimental when you need to be rational will become an obstacle in your path. Learn to curb this habit otherwise you may have to pay a heavy price, advises Ganesha. The comfortable gesture by your beloved will make you feel better. You will be the best person to take care of your sweetheart. You should be helpful to your partner now. Understanding, patience, and commitment are the keys to ensuring a smooth relationship. It’s going to be a good day for you, says Ganesha. You are not going to face any health problem today. Most of the tasks which you will be handling today will be need based. You should avoid taking initiatives today. You should respect others’ concern for you and should reciprocate. This will help you earn lot of goodwill or blessings. Don’t be stingy. If your money can help a family member, go for it. Today, you have no choice but to work in the office without complaining about the ambience and the time constraints. It will be a challenging day for you as you are not used to such constraints. Compose yourself and face the challenge, suggests Ganesha.

Some conflicts could crop up in the morning on the domestic front. However, they will cease to be a cause of annoyance as the day progresses. Come evening and you will be in as fine a mood as you ever were, ready to spend time basking in the affection of your near and dear ones, says Ganesha. You will be quite helpful with your soulmate. Your stars predict a quality time with the love of your life. You may choose a destination where you will express your deep emotion. You may even capture a lovely moment of togetherness. A fascinating lovemaking will be in your mind. You will want to do everything for others today. You will sacrifice your time in the welfare of others. This will give you lot of satisfaction. Besides, you should have more liquid in your diet to maintain good water level and good health. If you have not capitalized or banked on your talent till date, today you should do that. Try to know the market and see where you can sell your talents. You surely have more potential to earn. Ganesha foresees an unambiguous change in your attitude. You will feel lazy when it comes to the profession. Smart work will be your top priority. You may feel a stronger emotional attachment with your colleagues. By helping others with their problems, you will display your affectionate nature.
